thought.text: Need the PostgreSQL APT repository for PostGIS:

reasoning_content: PostGIS requires the PGDG repository (Ubuntu's default repository may not have 15's postgis-3, or postgresql hasn't been installed yet). Let's add the PGDG apt repository.

action.command:
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get install -y -qq curl ca-certificates gnupg lsb-release > /dev/null 2>&1
install -d /usr/share/keyrings
curl -fsSL https://www.postgresql.org/media/keys/ACCC4CF8.asc -o /usr/share/keyrings/pgdg.gpg
echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/pgdg.gpg] https://apt.postgresql.org/pub/repos/apt jammy-pgdg main" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/pgdg.list
apt-get update -qq 2>&1 | tail -1
apt-get install -y -qq postgresql-15 postgresql-15-postgis-3 2>&1 | tail -2
ls /usr/lib/postgresql/15/bin/ | head -5
